# Welcome to Our Livery!

![CWB_FreeBoating2022_boat_overhead_3.jpg](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/1675124149134-AYLOCSDBXU6UEIS17RGX/CWB_FreeBoating2022_boat_overhead_3.jpg)

## What is a "Livery"?
The livery is The Center for Wooden Boats' rental fleet of historic and classic wooden boats. It operates seasonally from mid-March through October. Anyone can rent; members get discounts and can buy rental passes. [Check out our membership program here.](https://www.cwb.org/membership)

## How does it work?
Rentals are first-come, first-served walk-up; reservations aren't accepted. [Exhibit and Livery Hours Can Be Found Here.](https://www.cwb.org/hourslocations)

- **Free Public Peapod Program:** a free one-hour rowboat rental, limited to one per week, walk-up. [Learn more here](https://www.cwb.org/free-programs)
- **Free [Sunday Public Sail](https://www.cwb.org/public-sail):** last Sunday of each month, for people with no sailing experience.
- **Sailboats** require a one-time CWB [sailing checkout](https://www.cwb.org/slu-checkout), scheduled in advance online ([here](https://www.cwb.org/slu-checkout)). Outside certifications are not accepted in its place. Checkouts remain valid for one year after your most recent sailboat use. New to sailing? See our lessons [HERE.](https://www.cwb.org/adult-sailing)
- Full livery [rules can be found here](https://www.cwb.org/livery-policies).

## As of October 1, 2025, all CWB adult programing and boat rentals are now subject to Washington state sales tax.

## Rental Passes Available for CWB Members
Become a member: [membership here](https://www.cwb.org/membership).
### $350 - Small boat Pass
Covers CWB sailboats with 3 or fewer passengers. Does not include rowboats, canoes, kayaks or paddleboards. [Small Boat Pass](https://centerforwoodenboats2.my.site.com/gs/s/?eventId=a1KVy000015NeHV)
### $550 Weekday Pass
Unlimited weekday use of sail and human-powered boats for 365 days. [Weekday Pass](https://centerforwoodenboats2.my.site.com/gs/s/?eventId=a1KVy000015NPZ6)
### $800 - Die Hard pass
Unlimited use of sail and human-powered boats any time the livery is open, for 365 days. [Die-Hard Pass](https://centerforwoodenboats2.my.site.com/gs/s/?eventId=a1KVy000015NDNe)

## Our Rental Boats
## SOUTH LAKE UNION RENTAL BOATS
Rates are per boat, per hour, with a one-hour minimum.

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/37777091-4f57-49cc-84b0-9116ed572c6c/1000015073.jpg)

### LARGE SAILBOATS
1-6 people, sloop-rigged. $80/hr members · $100/hr general.

![Blanchard Junior Knockabout under sail](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/1553294424867-APTA1A7TMRP1116AMV13/sailing+in+a+blanchard.jpg)
![Lightening sailboat rigged at the dock](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/1553294496181-K8RE53JICGPS72MTLDUK/Roseburg%2BLightning.jpg)

[Learn more about these historic boats here](https://blanchardsailing.org)

1-2 people. $25/hr members · $35/hr general.

![canoes](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/1553295553104-S8Z18B5LCAPKDUR0QOYM/image-asset.jpeg)

### DOUBLE & SINGLE KAYAKS
1-2 people. $25/hr members · $35/hr general.

![kayaks](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/1553295613536-Q7BOH3L61B0UC0COSG27/image-asset.jpeg)

Pedal boats (2-6 adults) are also offered. Motorboats are not available for rent at this location; private charters on motorized wooden vessels are available.

### Renting FAQs
- Boats must stay on Lake Union between the Fremont and University Bridges, and may only dock at CWB.
- Boats are due back 15 minutes before closing. After the one-hour minimum, time is prorated in 15-minute increments.
- Personal flotation devices are provided free for all ages, including babies.
- No alcohol on rental boats. Picnic food is fine if you clean up.
- No fishing, swimming or smoking.
- No racing unless the race is CWB-sanctioned.
- No lockers or storage — bring your valuables and a cell phone with you.
- Dogs are welcome but must be leashed on CWB docks.
- Need a checkout? [schedule a sailing checkout](https://www.cwb.org/slu-checkout).
